whatChangedVsPriorAudit: COMPLETE REDESIGN of the arb path. REMOVED: the arbitrary low-level router.call(callData) + per-(router,selector) routerSelectorAllowed allowlist (the prior CC-1 trust-core / Medium). NOW: keeper supplies only borrowVY + a typed Leg[] route {DexKind enum (UniV2/UniV3/ValinityDAX), whitelisted router, tokenIn, tokenOut, extra=fee/poolId}; the CONTRACT builds each swap call itself (recipient hardcoded = bot, amountOutMinimum = 0), sizes each leg at 100% of balance. ADDED: VGO keeper-reward integration (beginReward/payReward, best-effort try/catch; keeper reimbursed by VGO gas-refund+bonus, NOT from arb profit), minProfitVY anti-grief floor. Caller profit-share REMOVED (payoutBps deprecated/inert; 100% profit -> Buyback Officer). Storage layout preserved (payoutBps + routerSelectorAllowed retained as inert; vgo + minProfitVY appended into old __gap; __gap 50->48).

audit.workflow: wc33q498d (64 agents, 26 survived / 29 refuted) — 8 dimensions, adversarial refutation
audit.verdict: CLOSED for the permissionless executeArb flow — PRINCIPAL can never be exfiltrated to an arbitrary address, even by a malicious INTERMEDIATE-leg whitelisted router (any principal diversion breaks finalVY>=borrowVY -> atomic pullTokens rollback; VYBalanceNotZero forces bot to end at 0 VY). Swap calls contract-built (recipient=this, minOut=0), no caller calldata. Treasury made whole every tx; no unbacked mint without an upgrade. Breakable only in admin/upgrade-gated ways (below), none permissionless.
audit.critical: C-1 _authorizeUpgrade (ADMIN_ROLE, no on-contract timelock): malicious impl bypasses all invariants and calls vyt.pullTokens(attacker,...) with no repay. CORRECTED: bot is a STANDARD (non-priority) OFFICER on VYT, so pullTokens cushion applies (CUSHION=350k, TARGET=7M) -> ~6.65M VY/call ceiling, repeatable as VYT refills (further VY mint-rate-limited). NOT unbounded. Dominant lever; acute pre-handoff (admin still KMS EOA-class, no timelock).
audit.high: H-1 final-leg whitelisted router can skim profit-above-floor: SwapOutputZero checks increase not amount, so a malicious VY-terminal router returns exactly borrowVY+minProfitVY and pockets the rest = actualProfit-minProfitVY (principal safe; 100% of profit if minProfitVY==0). The whitelist IS load-bearing for PROFIT integrity. H-2 setMinProfitVY has no lower bound -> admin can zero the floor (removes H-1 cap + enables VGO-reward farming when vgo set).
audit.mediums: M-1 setVgo adds UNAUDITED VGO trust (when set, VGO needs VYT.OFFICER_ROLE -> could pull VYT during payReward; VMB itself can't be drained: best-effort try/catch, nonReentrant, one-way VGO->keeper; vgo=0 live = zero exposure). M-2 dual DEFAULT_ADMIN+ADMIN grant at init -> handoff must migrate AND revoke both (DEFAULT_ADMIN administers ADMIN).
audit.lows: L-1 setBuybackOfficer profit-redirect (not principal). L-2 FoT/VY-whitelist-loss are fail-safe reverts (no extraction); minOut=0 sandwich = profit-suppression only, bounded by repay+floor. I6 DexKind no upper-bound check (falls through to DAX; refuted exploitable — ABI rejects out-of-range enum, DAX not whitelisted).
audit.designImprovement: MAJOR upgrade vs prior impl 0x16b66a22: removed arbitrary router.call(callData) + per-(router,selector) allowlist (old CC-1 trust-core). Residual exfil surface shrank from 'any whitelisted (router,selector) with attacker calldata' to 'final-leg router skims profit-above-floor (H-1)'.
audit.handoff: Migrate DEFAULT_ADMIN+ADMIN (0x8310eA7E) to a governance TimelockController w/ real upgrade delay; readback-assert gov holds BOTH before renouncing either from the KMS (handoff_mevbot_v2_to_governance.ts). Timelock setVgo (do NOT call until VGO audited), setMinProfitVY (keep>0; add vgo!=0=>floor!=0 guard), setRouterWhitelist (canonical routers only), setBuybackOfficer. setPaused->fast guardian. No rescue function (verify upgrades add none). Keep bot on VY fee-exemption list.
